title: pfaffia lanata
intro: Pfaffia lanata, commonly known as suma, is a plant native to South America, specifically in the tropical regions of Brazil and Argentina. It has been used for centuries in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to act as a diuretic, reduce inflammation, and improve digestion. The therapeutic actions of Pfaffia lanata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as arthritis, high blood pressure, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Pfaffia lanata include polysaccharides, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
